name: Prof. Beatrice Lund

bands.name: Keep going
lines: You travelled to a planet and wrote down almost nothing.
Go outside. Look at things. Then write them down.

bands.name: Encouragement
lines: There is a real start here. I can see where you have been.
Keep at it. I mean that.

bands.name: Pass
lines: I have seen worse from students

bands.name: Credit
lines: A few gaps, but I can tell you were there.

bands.name: Perfect
lines: I once got lost on a planet with one continent.

spam: This is the same homework you just sent me.
Same again. Send it once more and I will fail you.
That is three. I have stopped reading. I warned you.
locked: Bring me {n} new things first. Then I will read it.
reveal: Since it is complete, here is the full marking sheet. You earned it.
